name: Wilkes Subglacial Basin
description_en: East Antarctica's largest marine-based ice sheet sector. A deep overdeepening sits behind a narrow coastal ridge — if the grounding line retreats past the ridge, MISI could unlock 3–4 m of sea level rise.
description_zh: 东南极最大的海洋性冰盖扇区。沿海窄脊后方是深层过深地形——一旦接地线退过该脊，MISI可能释放3–4米海平面上升。

key_facts_en: Contains enough ice to raise sea level by ~3.8 meters
Protected by a narrow coastal ridge — once breached, retreat accelerates
Recent observations show warm water intruding beneath the ice
key_facts_zh: 含有约3.8米海平面当量的冰
受沿海窄脊保护——一旦突破，退缩加速
近期观测显示暖水正在冰下入侵
